steps.question: In 1974, the brave woman who led the women of Reni village to hug trees was ...

questionMeaning.hi: 1974 में रेणी गाँव की औरतों का नेतृत्व किसने किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: 1974 mein Reni gaanv ki auraton ka netritva kisne kiya?

steps.question: Long before Chipko, in 1730, Amrita Devi and the Bishnoi people gave their lives to save which trees in Rajasthan?

questionMeaning.hi: 1730 में अमृता देवी और बिश्नोई लोगों ने राजस्थान में किन पेड़ों के लिए जान दी?
questionMeaning.hinglish: 1730 mein Amrita Devi aur Bishnoi logon ne Rajasthan mein kin pedon ke liye jaan di?

steps.question: Which leader is famous for the Chipko Movement?
